newsitem.title: USA: Isomedix to dispose of Skyland Scientific.
newsitem.headline: Isomedix to dispose of Skyland Scientific.

text.p: Isomedix Inc said on Friday that it has affirmed a plan to exit its Skyland Scientific Services Inc subsidiary.
As a result, the company said it expects to incur a fourth quarter disposal cost of about $1.7 million, or $0.24 per share.
The company said it also expects to incur a fourth quarter charge relating to Skyland's operations in the amount of about $385,000, or $.05 per share.
In addition, the company will incur a $0.06 a share charge for the fourth quarter with respect to continuing operations, the largest item being the disposal of certain fixed assets.

Excluding the effects of these charges, income from continuing operations is also expected to show an increase in the fourth quarter versus a year ago, reflecting the improved revenue stream, the company said.
Isomedix said it is currently in discussions with other parties for the potential transfer of the Skyland business.
Skyland provides contract consulting, calibration and validation services to assist manufacturers of healthcare products in complying with Good Manufacturing Practices.
Isomedix said it intends to focus on its growing core business, contract sterilization.
The company said it expects fourth quarter revenues for its sterilization business to show a strong increase versus a year ago.
